note: The systems the New Machine assistant offers to download (docs/VIRTUALIZATION.md 4.1 and 3.9, "The Linux download cards"). Read by the app (apps/machines/catalog.js, bundled) and by the admin helper as root (server/src/vm/vmcatalog.c, from /usr/lib/lordos/assets/machines/systems.json): JS names an entry and an architecture, never a URL. An entry names a release, not a file: 'dir' is the maker's folder for it, 'sums' the maker's own SHA-256 list in that folder (or 'sumsPattern', the list's name to look for in the folder's listing when the name changes per build), and 'file' the image's name as an extended regular expression; the newest matching name in the list is taken, and the download must have the SHA-256 the list gives for it, or it is thrown away. 'fileDir' is where the image itself is fetched when it isn't 'dir' (a mirror redirector). 'approxMb' is only what the card says before the list is read; 'maxMb' is the most a download may be. Before any hash in a list is trusted, the list's OpenPGP signature is checked (vmcatalog.c, pkg/pgp.c): 'signature' is how the maker signs it ('detached', a file named 'name' in the same folder, or 'clearsigned', the list itself), 'keys' the maker's key file, pinned in the package (packaging/keys/machines, installed in /usr/lib/lordos/assets/machines/keys), and 'fingerprints' the primary keys of that file that may sign; a list that isn't signed, or whose signature doesn't verify with them, is refused. 'keySource' says where the key was fetched, 'fingerprintChecked' where its fingerprint was compared, over https, with the one the maker publishes. 'hashSource' says where each hash comes from; 'checked' is when the entry was last tried. Order is the cards' order.

systems.name: Debian
systems.hashSource: SHA256SUMS published by Debian next to the images (cdimage.debian.org, current release), its OpenPGP signature SHA256SUMS.sign checked with Debian's CD signing key
systems.keySource: keyring.debian.org (HKPS lookup of the fingerprint), fetched 2026-11-06
systems.fingerprintChecked: https://www.debian.org/CD/verify, 2026-11-06 (Debian CD signing key, the one its current lists are signed with)

systems.name: Ubuntu
systems.hashSource: SHA256SUMS published by Canonical in the release folder (releases.ubuntu.com for amd64, cdimage.ubuntu.com for arm64), its OpenPGP signature SHA256SUMS.gpg checked with Canonical's CD image signing key
systems.keySource: keyserver.ubuntu.com (HKPS lookup of the fingerprint), fetched 2026-11-06

systems.name: Fedora
systems.hashSource: the CHECKSUM file published by Fedora in the release folder (dl.fedoraproject.org; its name changes per build, so it is found in the folder's listing), OpenPGP clear-signed with the Fedora 45 key; only the signed text is used
systems.keySource: https://fedoraproject.org/fedora.gpg (the Fedora 45 key of that file), fetched 2026-11-06

systems.name: Kali
systems.hashSource: SHA256SUMS published by Kali in cdimage.kali.org/current, its OpenPGP signature SHA256SUMS.gpg checked with Kali's archive signing key
